description:
As a site administrator
  I want every user defined in cucumber.js worldParameters.users to be
  able to log in
  So that the suite has known-good fixtures for every role on the
  Standard profile before any role-specific scenarios run

description:
As an admin user
  I want to verify that the Web Security recipe enables every security module
  So that I know the recipe ran cleanly during install

elements.name: Modules report status page lists Web Security as enabled

I should see "Login with email or username"

description:
As a site administrator
  I want the user/IP flood thresholds shipped by the recipe to be present
  So that brute-force login attempts hit the throttle quickly

description:
As a site administrator

I should see "Unrecognized username or password"
